strings.subtitle: — Simbulali semafayela —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kuhudvuta nekushiya akukho. Sebentisa likinobho lelingaphansi.
strings.shred_button: B U L A L A
strings.ssd_warning:
Caphela! Ku-SSD, indlela yekubhala ngenhla ayincomi kubulawa ngenca ye-TRIM.
Loluhlelo lwelwa-HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ifayela "{name}" litabhaliwa ngenhla futsi licitfwe.

Chubeka?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS imitja yedatha lehlukile (ADS) ayisebenti.
• Ijenali ye-USN ayihlantshwa.
• Emakhophi etsembu nekuhambisana kwelifu
  (OneDrive, njll.) akukhintseki.
strings.status_full: Lokucuketfwe kubhalwe ngenhla ngcobo ngemakhulu. Kukhipha akunakwentiwa — emathulusi abona makhulu kuphela.
strings.status_fast: Inhloko, umsila nemitja lengu-4 MB kubhalwe ngenhla. Lokusala akukashintjwa, kodvwa ngenca yetikhalo, kukhipha konkhe ngemathulusi elwati akunakwentiwa. Etidokhumendeni letiyimfihlo sebenzisa IMODO LEPHELELE.
strings.status_empty: Ifayela belingenalutto, kubhala ngenhla bekungadzingeki. Licitfwe.
strings.error_permission: Angikwati kufinyelela ifayela. Lingahle livulekile kolunye luhlelo. Vala bese ucubuka futsi.
strings.error_is_symlink: Lena yindzawonye yesifanekiselo. Tindzawonye angeke ticitswe — ifayela lelibitako litahlala liphelele.
strings.error_reparse: Lena yifayela yendzawo (OneDrive noma lokufanako). Idatha yayo iselufini, hhayi kudisiki — akukho lokungacitfwa lapha.
strings.error_not_file: Lena akulona ifayela (ifolda noma lokunye). Bika ifayela.
strings.error_hardlinks: Leli fayela linemitja lesindzako leminye ({n} konkhe). Imitja lesindzako ayinamkhulu — emagama onkhe ayalingana. Uma ucitsa ngendlela yanyalo, idatha itabhaliwa ngenhla futsi incishiswe ku-32 byte, kodvwa lokusala kutahlala kufinyeleleka ngemitja leminye. Citsa tonkhe tmitja kucala.
strings.error_compressed:
Ifayela licindzetelekile, licashuniwe noma lintofotofo. Kubhala ngenhla ngemakhulu akuncomi kubulawa kwedatha lendzala ngoba i-NTFS igcina ngenye indlela.

Susa sici: chofoza kwesokudla → Timphawu → Lokucakile → susa tiki ku "Cindzetela" na/noma "Cashuna". Bese ugijima i-SHREDDER futsi.
